name: Reverse super: dash right, flip the stick left in the freeze and jump
techNote: A plain floor, the finish 300-420 u left of the start. Stand 10 ticks, dash right with jump on the dash's first freeze frame and the stick flipped left through the freeze (lockX -1), then hold left: CheckForSuperJump sends the super's momentum the stick's way (MoveAxis.x), -876 after the tick's decay, while the dash still carries the dot forward on its tick (Velocity 1670 on the jump tick, 28.7 u right in all); the run speed turns from +460 to -460 over 7 ticks and the dot reaches the finish on tick 28.
